title: Perfect for a photo booth or just as decor!
text: Perfect for a photo booth or just as decor!. Don't use the glue dots. Scotch tape was perfect. Can be used as props for photos or wall decor. We used them as both. Great for our grad party and our senior night party!

product_metadata.title: Big Dot of Happiness Red 2023 Graduation Party Photo Booth Props Kit - 20 Count
features: 20-Piece Graduation Party Photo Booth Props Kit INCLUDES 20 Red Grad - Best is Yet to Come photo booth props, 20 prop kit sticks and stickers for assembly. EASY ASSEMBLY: Simply attach the printed DIY photo booth props to the prop kit sticks with included reinforcing stickers.

PERFECT FOR ANY CROWD! Photo booth props are fun red graduation party supplies for adults and kids - everyone will love the funny faces on these Red Grad - Best is Yet to Come graduation party photo booth props. Take entertaining and shareable party photos of your friends and family while making memories with these funny photo booth props!

GRADUATION PARTY DECORATIONS: There are many fun ways to use these cute photo booth props! Use as intended at home, school or work and take party photos to share; add them to vases and floral arrangements as a fun graduation centerpiece; or accent your red candy buffet by displaying them in apothecary candy jars!

HIGH-QUALITY PARTY SUPPLIES: Red Grad - Best is Yet to Come photo booth props are professionally printed on thick cardstock paper. They will arrive cut out and ready to assemble with the included prop kit sticks and stickers.
MADE IN THE USA: Red Grad - Best is Yet to Come - Graduation Party Photo Booth Props Kit is designed and manufactured at our Wisconsin facility using materials that are Made in America.
